svg.aria-label: Education: MBA in Business Analytics and Human Resources (2024 to 2026, grade A) and Bachelor of Computer Applications (2020 to 2023, grade A), both at BVIMR, Bharati Vidyapeeth University, offline. Certifications: Diploma in Data Science and Diploma in Artificial Intelligence, Boston Institute of Analytics, offline; Business Analytics Plus, IMS Proschool (2026), offline; Business Analytics Specialization, Wharton Online, University of Pennsylvania, online; Forward Deployed Engineering programme, NeuraPath Academy, offline, in progress. Side quest: basketball, 1st place in the inter-college tournament two years running (BCA) and 1st place intra-college (MBA).
